gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-mro: Eater looks dark and snarling, with thin strokes that stay solid and gaps between its letters. Noto Sans Mro sits underneath as a modern sans-serif with dense, tall middles, so the menace up top gets a steady, readable partner.
gen-almendra-display-gf-numans: Ornate and bookish, Almendra Display keeps its letters open and its x-height tall. And Numans, a clean sans with widely spaced, plump lowercase, would let a long page unroll slowly and without strain.
gen-audiowide-gf-onest: Audiowide sets its glyphs like wide-spaced tiles, with strokes that never thicken or thin across the curves. Onest is the friendly sans-serif partner.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-multani: Eater arrives dark and aggressive, all spiky gaps. Noto Sans Multani, a modern sans-serif with a lofty x-height and an e that opens wide, is what makes the pair work: menace above, clarity below.
gen-fs-bonny-fs-plein: Refined and literary, Bonny holds modest contrast between its heavy and light strokes, with curves that gape and lines set tight. Plein, the plain sans, simply keeps a clear channel leading into each round letter, doing the quiet work Bonny leaves alone.
gen-almendra-display-gf-open-sans: Open Sans reads smoothly, with no clogged curves and sturdy, bulky lowercase proportions, beneath the ornate Almendra Display heading. Together they feel literary yet current.
gen-audiowide-gf-orienta: Audiowide has no thick-thin shift at all, only tiled glyphs with wide grout lines and tall lowercase. Orienta, a modern plain sans with breathing counters and little gap between cases, would carry paragraphs smoothly.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Noto Sans Myanmar forms a thick, heavy-looking band of text with a broad, welcoming c. Noto Sans Myanmar can stay at a generous size, since the plain sans carries weight on its own beneath Eater.
gen-fs-bonny-fs-amulya: Bonny's tame contrast never goes razor thin. Amulya, a contemporary sans, keeps its curve gaps generous below, so the tight, literary lines above get a modern, open companion.
gen-almendra-display-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans draws one stroke thickness everywhere, crisp even when shrunk. Against Almendra Display's ornate, literary heading, its uniform lines and lowercase rising close to capitals make the sharpest difference.
